# teams_audio_conferencing_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing AudioConferencingPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_toll_free_dialin` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowTollFreeDialin parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `meeting_invite_phone_numbers` (String) Maps to the -MeetingInvitePhoneNumbers parameter.
